payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: What color is the same small disc in the case near the center of the source image in the edited image?
node.criteria: Compare the source and edited images and establish that the edited object corresponds to the small disc in the case near the center of the source. Complete if that same disc is visibly white; partial if its color visibly changed from black toward white but it is not white; absent if the same disc is established and remains black with no requested change; unknown if correspondence or color change cannot be established from the images.
node.binding: Target: the small disc in its case near the center of the source image; track that same object across source and edited images. Do not identify it by proximity to the dark object or substitute another white disc.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.
